summary: Tested only the Endorsements feature, backend and frontend. Backend: 10/10 pytest tests pass. These cover the public GET default, PUT returning 401 when signed out and 403 for a non-admin, 422 for a bad layout or empty/whitespace-only text or name, trimming of blank book entries, persistence, and no _id leaking. Frontend: everything requested works. Dashboard link goes to /admin/endorsements. The 3 layout buttons switch the preview, and with no rows it shows [Placeholder] samples. Add, reorder (the up button on the first row and the down button on the last row are disabled), delete and save all work, with a success toast, and the data persists after reload (books cleaned to 'Book One\nBook Two'). An empty name shows the error toast. /book hides the section when there are no items and shows Spotlight, List and Cards correctly. Spotlight prev/next cycle and wrap around (1/2 -> 2/2 -> 1/2). Books show as 'Author of Book One, Book Two'. A non-admin gets no admin link and is redirected from /admin/endorsements to /dashboard. At 390px mobile the list and cards layouts don't overflow (scrollWidth 390). One design bug: in the Cards layout, empty grid cells show as a solid grey block.

design_issues.screen: /book and admin preview, Cards layout (Endorsements.jsx Cards)
issues: The grid uses 'gap-px bg-line' for its dividers. When the number of items isn't a multiple of the column count (3 columns on lg, 2 on md), the empty cells show the container's bg-line color (rgb(39,39,42)) as a large solid grey rectangle. Seen with 4 items on desktop. Fix: use per-card borders (e.g. border-line with negative margins / divide utilities) instead of gap+bg, or put a bg-surface wrapper behind the grid so unused cells match the page.

action_items: Fix the grey empty-cell block in the Cards layout when the item count doesn't fill the last row
critical_code_review_comments: AdminEndorsements.jsx: api.get('/endorsements') has no .catch. If it fails, rows stay null and the page shows the Loader forever. Add an error state or toast.
Spotlight keeps index state in useState(0) and uses i % length. That's fine, but the admin preview doesn't reset the index when rows are deleted, so the counter can jump. Minor.
Backend: max_length is set on fields, but nothing limits the length of each book title string. Consider Field(max_length=200) per book.
seed_data_creation: Seeded a temporary non-admin test_endo_member@example.com in Mongo (bcrypt) and deleted it afterwards. Endorsements reset to {layout:'cards', items:[]}, verified via GET.
test_credentials: Admin test_admin@example.com / test1234 (provided by main agent). /app/memory/test_credentials.md does not list this account.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Endorsements are stored in db.settings _id='endorsements'. The pytest module's admin fixture resets the data to cards/[] on teardown. It needs the member test_endo_member@example.com/test1234 to be seeded first, otherwise the 403 test is skipped.
